messages:
kevin: Quick heads-up — I'm rolling a change to use batch annotations for ExternalSecrets in prod to cut down on Vault API QPS. Wanted a quick config review before I flip the flag.

sasha: Nice. Can you paste the exact annotation you plan to add? Also any change to refreshInterval or rotation window? :eyes:

kevin: sure — snippet i'm testing in staging:```yaml
apiVersion: external-secrets.io/v1beta1
kind: ExternalSecret
metadata:
  name: service-api-credentials
  annotations:
    external-secrets.redwood.sh/batch: "true"
    external-secrets.redwood.sh/batch-window: "60s" # aggregate requests for 60s
spec:
  refreshInterval: "1m"
  secretStoreRef:
    name: vault-ss
    kind: ClusterSecretStore
  target:
    name: service-api-credentials
    template:
      type: Opaque
      data:
        # mapping from secret keys -> keys in k8s secret
        API_KEY: api/key
```

maria: If we enable batching, we need to ensure the Vault token TTL/renewal covers the batch window. Are we expecting any change to the Vault role TTL?

oliver: FYI the Vault role for that k8s service account currently has "token_ttl": "1h" and "token_max_ttl": "4h" so 60s batches are trivial. But rotation job for the secret is on a daily cadence outside of refreshInterval.

kevin: Right — batching only affects the number of read requests, not the rotation cadence. Still want to be sure caching doesn't mask a failure during rotation. Thinking to add a small healthcheck that fails if secretVersion != Vault version in the annotations.

infra-bot: deploy-ctl: staging deploy started for external-secrets v0.5.2 by kevin — logs: https://ci.redwood/integrations/12345

sasha: Also double-check RBAC in Terraform — ExternalSecrets' controller needs access to read the ServiceAccount token projection, plus we added a new cluster role binding last week. If you changed the SA name in the manifest, the TF var needs update.

kevin: good call. Terraform change is additive:```hcl
resource "kubernetes_service_account" "external_secrets" {
  metadata {
    name = var.external_secrets_sa_name
    namespace = "external-secrets"
  }
}

resource "kubernetes_cluster_role_binding" "es_crb" {
  metadata {
    name = "external-secrets-controller"
  }
  role_ref {
    api_group = "rbac.authorization.k8s.io"
    kind = "ClusterRole"
    name = "external-secrets-role"
  }
  subject {
    kind = "ServiceAccount"
    name = kubernetes_service_account.external_secrets.metadata[0].name
    namespace = "external-secrets"
  }
}
```

maria: Can you add a small note in the TF change explaining why batching is needed (cost/QPS) so reviewers don't flip it back later?

kevin: will do. Also adding a toggle via a kustomize overlay so we can enable per-cluster.

oliver: One more thing — for secrets wiring, make sure the ExternalSecret's `dataFrom` entries preserve the Vault path metadata. We had an incident where a missing `metadata.key` caused a key name collision.

kevin: thanks, i'll add `secretTemplate` that maps full key names. Patch incoming in ~30m. Ping me if you see anything odd in staging. :thumbsup:
